differential.name: Hypertensive chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Elevated creatinine (1.6 mg/dL) with stage 1 hypertension and obesity suggests renal impairment from long‑standing hypertension.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic MCV (~46 fL) with high platelet count (407 ×10³/µL) is classic for reactive thrombocytosis secondary to iron deficiency.

differential.name: Beta‑thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Marked microcytosis with normal‑high hemoglobin (16.5 g/dL) points to a hemoglobinopathy rather than true iron‑deficiency anemia.

differential.name: Metabolic syndrome
differential.rationale: Co‑existence of obesity (BMI >30), prediabetes (HbA1c 6.2 %), low HDL (29 mg/dL) and hypertension fulfills diagnostic criteria.

differential.name: Reactive thrombocytosis from acute bronchitis
differential.rationale: Recent acute bronchitis can provoke a mild inflammatory‑driven rise in platelets, contributing to the observed thrombocytosis.
